test_title: PYST 11: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 15,000 invested at compound interest (compounding annually) at the rate of 12% per annum for 2 years. Find the compound interest.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 15,000

Rate (R) = 12% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P(1 + R/100)T - P

**Calculation:**

CI = 15000(1 + 12/100)² - 15000

CI = 15000(1 + 0.12)² - 15000

CI = 15000(1.12)² - 15000

CI = 15000 × 1.2544 - 15000

CI = 18816 - 15000

CI = 3816

**The compound interest is Rs. 3816.**
